🍓 HOW TO ENTER
1. Like this Reel
2. Follow @mrsurprisetoys 
3. Tag 3 friends in the comments
4. Comment the name of the style you would like to receive and tell us why!

🥞 GIVEAWAY PERIOD
Opens: August 15, 2026
Closes: August 23, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET
Selected winners announced: August 25, 2026

⛲️ Mr.Surprise will review all eligible entries and select 6 winners based on completion of the entry requirements, as well as the relevance and thoughtfulness of their comments.

Each selected winner will receive the Come4Free BJD style they wished for in their comment. Selected winners will be asked to confirm their preferred Mr. Surprise pickup location. If they are unable to pick up their prize, shipping within Canada may be arranged.

Selected winners will be announced and contacted only by @mrsurprisetoys .

🧃 Please note: The giveaway prizes are the opened dolls featured in this unboxing Reel and are not sealed, brand-new items. The selection is final.

Good luck! We can’t wait to see which style you choose. 💫

🎐 SURPRISE — WE’RE NOW CELEBRATING FOR TWO DAYS!
Due to popular demand, Surprise Matsuri Market 2026 has added an extra date! Join us for a full weekend featuring 145+ vendors across two days, with various activities and mini-games each day. ✨

🍡 Inspired by the lively spirit of a Japanese summer festival, Surprise Matsuri Market brings creativity, community, and festive Matsuri vibes together in the heart of Toronto. 

Discover unique art, handmade creations, collectibles, and plenty of surprises as you explore the market under the lanterns.

🎏 SURPRISE MATSURI MARKET 2026
📅 11 AM–7 PM, Sept. 5–6 2026
📍 Lower Ground at The Well
486 Front St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0V2
🎟️ FREE ENTRY

More event details will be revealed soon—stay tuned and get ready to celebrate the end of summer with us! 🎆

Please note: There will be no fireworks at the event. Fireworks are featured solely as part of the market’s visual branding and theme.
